seed_ledger.name: Fort Cherry power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Range Resources supplies gas from nearby Marcellus wells to a Liberty Energy gas plant in the Fort Cherry district, but no source names a lateral, tap or route. Trade press (DCD, Nasdaq, Penn Biz Report, NGI search) shows only the April 2025 alliance. The Robinson Township supervisors May 2026 minutes show subdivision approvals only. No state air permit, FERC prior notice, EIA row or utility docket was found naming a pipe. Searches run: 7. Sources: DCD (alliance, no pipe), Robinson Township minutes (subdivisions only), web searches on DEP, FERC and EIA (nothing).

evidence.note: alliance, Range supplies gas, no pipeline named

seed_ledger.name: Kingsboro NetZero Data Center power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: campus is described as behind-the-meter gas near a transmission line, no lateral sourced. Local reporting says the developer, Energy Storage Solutions, has since dropped Kingsboro and Tarboro, so the project may be dead. Residents doubted gas availability. No NC air permit, FERC or NCUC filing found. Searches run: 7. Sources: WFAE (gas doubts, 900 MW), Rocky Mount Telegram and TMCnet (project dropped), listings (transmission line proximity only).

evidence.note: 900 MW campus, doubts on gas availability, no lateral
